text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On Sonon Elfie's stream, a new promotional 
project for the U.A.F. was launched. Its 
name is "Athlete Future."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The piece delves into the current state of 
the finalists, putting a spotlight on the 
"changes" each competitor underwent 
through the U.A.F.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many athletes are finding opportunities to 
interact with the fans from their active 
racing days.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was clear proof that the significance 
of the "U.A.F." that Ryoka Tsurugi had 
envisioned was truly taking shape.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, an email arrives. The contents 
were— "Information Regarding the U.A.F. 
Finals Venue Tour."
